City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts Regular Meeting
AGENDA
FEBRUARY 2, 2026 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.

2.

3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.

1.

2.

1.
Generate ideas that could help generate revenue funding to contribute to the Pacific View Arts Center with a goal for this work plan year to be a list of ideas generated.
a.
Discussion about zoning and permitting for the Pacific View Arts Center with Scott Drapkin, Director of Development Services.
b.
Commission discussion on Work Plan Item (#4).
2.
Recommend goals and policies for Arts that are consistent with all the other General Plan Elements (Work Plan Item #13).
a.
Poinsettia Room is available for a Special Meeting/Workshop, from 5pm to 7pm on Monday, March 9 or Thursday, March 19.
b.
Meeting Plan: Inviting guests/public comment, areas of concern, and review what is other city’s general plan.
3.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Donation Update (Work Plan Item #7).
a.
Currently scheduled to be reviewed by City Council on February 18, 2026.

Discuss Other Work Plan Items.
